title: Active Ownership and Market-Wide Information: Point-in-Time Backtest
paper: Between the Bells: Active Management and the Aggregation of Market-Wide Information
evidence_status: Real SEC 13F selected-manager breadth proxy and historical prices: negative net return, non-significant forecast; original paper not replicated; synthetic fixture is separate
signal: daily high-minus-low stock-return spread ranked by available SEC 13F selected-manager holding breadth (not true active-owned shares)
target: next-day S&P 500 close-to-close for prediction; next-day ETF open-to-close for executable strategy
notes: Real 2023-11 to 2024-11 pilot: 26 managers, 127 filings, 272 sessions, net return -8.77%, Sharpe -1.052, HAC p=0.803. Exact paper portfolio rules, dated CUSIP links and share ownership unavailable. Synthetic study is not market evidence.
test_commands: python backtest.py --prices data/synthetic/prices.csv --holdings data/synthetic/holdings.csv --market data/synthetic/market.csv --source-label synthetic --out outputs/synthetic
